Council Record
December the 6th 1869 7 o'clock P.M.
Council met pursuant to adjournment No Mayor Leander Brown Mayor in the Chair Roll called,
the following Aldermen answered to their names
Aldermen Burnett, Barnes, Konschke and
Collins

On motion the minutes of the last
meeting was not read.

Alderman Collins the following
resolution which was read and adopted
Be it Resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin that Lots No 254 and 255 in the
City Cemetery are hereby ordered for Sale and Lots No. 249 and 26a and hereby Condemned
for to be used as a Street in the said Cemetery.

An account was presented in favor
of Doctor Made Manfeter for Medical Services rendered in the case of [illegible] Cassidy
[illegible] in the City of Austin and on Motion it was laid on the table.

The Monthly report for the Month of
November was presented by the City Secretary & received.

The following appropriations were asked
for and was made by a unanimous Vote.

Victor Brown Policeman November 1869 | 40.00
Williams Mensick do do | 40.00
William McWilliams do do | 40.00
John Peterson for taking care of Engine | 6.00
Feeding Prisoners | 2.50
Removing dead Animals | 15.00
Porter Hire for Two Months &c | 6.00
Browned do to bringing in Hose | 43.00
| 192.79

On motion the Council adjourned
to the next regular Meeting
A. C. [illegible]
Recorder
